proposal.reason: Episode evidence: per-step completions tracked the disjoint-triple count closely, so throughput (not coverage breadth) was binding; the late endgame stalled with many tasks remaining and few commandable agents. charge and energy_risk were zero on nearly all candidates, so their weight is mostly idle. Hypothesis: keep the validated pair formula unchanged, sharpen the task term (stronger urgency for low-slack windows and stronger damping of long-duration triples relative to time_left) so quickly finishable tasks win, and move a little weight off the idle charge channel into task/imbalance. Unverified until replay on identical episodes.
